parameters.query: SELECT lead_id, company_name, status, reply_processed FROM leads WHERE email = '{{ $json.from_email }}' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO reply_inbox (from_email, subject, body_snippet, lead_id, sentiment, processed)
VALUES (
  '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.from_email }}',
  '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.body_snippet.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.lead_id }}',
  '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.sentiment }}',
  TRUE
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

UPDATE leads SET
  reply_detected_at = NOW(),
  reply_processed   = TRUE,
  reply_sentiment   = '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.sentiment }}',
  reply_snippet     = LEFT('{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.body_snippet }}', 500),
  needs_human       = FALSE,
  status = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.sentiment }}' = 'positive'    THEN 'replied_positive'::lead_status
    WHEN '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.sentiment }}' = 'unsubscribe' THEN 'dead'::lead_status
    ELSE 'replied_negative'::lead_status
  END,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id = '{{ $("Groq Classify Sentiment1").first().json.lead_id }}';
